name: iris-1099
description: Who needs a 1099 for 2025 or 2026 payments, from your own vendor-payments or 1099 report: the $600 and $2,000 thresholds, card and payment-network amounts left to the 1099-K, corporations exempt except attorneys and medical, missing W-9s, and IRIS Taxpayer Portal CSVs in batches of 100. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/iris-1099 locally; no account, no network, no LLM calls of its own. Prepared for your review, not tax advice.
